Investing nearly $300,000 into regulatory requirements and necessary studies, he was soon met with neighbor complaints that triggered additional demands. These included extensive environmental assessments and a permanent conservation deed restriction on two-thirds of his land. Undeterred by the financial and emotional strain, Chambers remains resolute in his quest to build a home.
title: Washington couple spent $300,000 on home plans; state wants 44 acres surrendered

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: In a groundbreaking initiative in New Orleans, discarded glass bottles are being turned into sand for coastal restoration. Known as Glass Half Full, this program has successfully redirected millions of pounds of glass from local landfills. Current research is examining the positive impact of this recycled glass sand on the growth and durability of wetland vegetation, providing a creative solution to Louisiana's ongoing coastal land loss issues.
title: New Orleans turns 12 million pounds of glass into sand to rebuild wetlands

author: DHRUV YADAV
description: Lieutenant Colonel Ardeshir Tarapore died bravely leading his regiment in 1965. His unit destroyed sixty enemy tanks while losing only nine during intense fighting. Tarapore refused evacuation even after sustaining wounds on the battlefield. He was posthumously awarded India's highest wartime gallantry award. The Poona Horse regiment has a distinguished history of service and valor.
title: Commander who would not leave: The battle that won Lt Col Tarapore the Param Vir Chakra

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: Cancer survivor Alexander Ackles-Dold reminisces about the compassion he received during his childhood hospital stays. In a heartfelt initiative, he spearheads a LEGO donation drive for the pediatric oncology clinic in Southlake. The project has amassed hundreds of LEGO figures and raised considerable funds, striving to offer young patients an engaging escape during their treatments. The Ackles-Dold family continues to gather donations to brighten the spirits of children battling cancer.
title: Teen cancer survivor donates 573 Lego figures to hospital that treated him

author: TOI LIFESTYLE DESK
description: Cricketer Rinku Singh is eagerly preparing for his wedding to Priya Saroj, slated for December 2026. His six-bedroom bungalow in Aligarh tells the story of his remarkable rise from humble beginnings. The house is tastefully designed with modern interiors and boasts a private swimming pool for downtime. Adorned with cricket memorabilia, including an iconic bat, this residence marks a pivotal moment in his personal and professional life.
title: Rinku Singh to marry Priya Saroj in December: Inside his Rs 3.5 crore Aligarh home

author: VIJAYA SRIVASTAVA
description: A devastating incident occurred overnight in Gaza City, where a six-storey apartment building crumbled, leaving at least ten Palestinians, including young children, dead. The aftermath has led to fears that numerous individuals may still be trapped beneath the debris. Rescue teams are actively searching for survivors and recovering bodies, amid reports that the building had been weakened by earlier Israeli attacks.
title: 10 dead, dozens missing after war-damaged apartment block collapses in Gaza

author: TOI TECH DESK
description: Oracle layoffs: Oracle's second round of job cuts this year arrived with the same termination email it sent in March. Signed "Oracle Leadership", the 6am note told employees their role was eliminated and "today is your last working day". Staff shared both versions on Reddit, Blind and X. In India, 1,000 to 1,500 mid- to senior-level employees may be affected, sources said, as Oracle's restructuring bill rises to $2.8 billion.
title: Read the 6 am email Oracle Leadership reused for its second round of layoffs this year

author: PRANAV SHUKLA
description: As India gears up for the 2027 ODI World Cup, emphasis is being placed on maintaining a consistent squad. Yuvraj Singh advocates for the development of a core group, allowing players regular opportunities to hone their skills. This strategy minimizes disruptive last-minute alterations ahead of pivotal tournaments, ensuring athletes gain adequate experience during the limited ODI match schedule.
title: 'Don't make changes': Yuvraj's warning to Gambhir and management ahead of 2027 WC

author: NIKHIL SHARMA
description: Two accused in the Gurgaon hit-and-run case were produced before a local court. They were sent to two days of police custody until September eighteenth. A video from the victim's bike camera showed her being knocked down. Police added an attempt-to-murder charge after examining the video evidence. The accused had crossed into Rajasthan after the incident occurred.
title: Gurgaon hit-and-run case: Kalyan Bainsla, cousin sent to 2-day police custody

author: DHRUV YADAV
description: Indian Army Chief General Dhiraj Seth is visiting Russia for three days of official engagements. He will hold talks on military cooperation and training with Russian officials. Discussions will focus on sustainment support for Russian-origin military equipment. Russia has also offered newer defence systems and joint production proposals. This visit highlights ongoing layered defence cooperation between the two nations.
title: Army chief General Dhiraj Seth to visit Russia in a bid to strengthen defence cooperation

author: TOI SCIENCE DESK
description: After being declared extinct in Britain, the large blue butterfly has made a remarkable return, flourishing across thirty-three different sites. Since 1983, its population has soared by an astounding 1,866%. This resurgence showcases a delicate ecological interplay with specific food plants and ants. Thanks to focused conservation efforts in habitat restoration and understanding its life cycle, the large blue stands as a powerful symbol of successful species recovery.
title: Britain brought back extinct butterfly; population has since surged 1,866%

author: TOI SCIENCE DESK
description: In Sarufutsu village, the burgeoning problem of scallop shell waste has taken center stage. A plastic manufacturing firm has crafted a groundbreaking material known as Shellstic using these shells. This eco-conscious innovation leads to the creation of Shellmet - an exceptionally durable helmet for fishermen, outperforming standard plastic versions. Such developments offer a promising approach to resolving industrial waste concerns sustainably.
title: Japanese village turns 40,000 tonnes of scallop shells into stronger helmets

description: In a troubling development, thousands of Bangladeshi expatriates in the UAE are facing unexpected visa cancellations, which has left many in a state of uncertainty. The Bangladeshi government is actively addressing the issue, pushing for a thorough examination of the reasons behind these cancellations. Many individuals who had traveled home for temporary breaks are now caught off-guard by the abrupt changes. It's estimated that around 1.

She initiated a bird monitoring project which provided evidence of habitat restoration benefits. Her research findings will be published in a national birding magazine this fall. Haakman also co-founded a local chapter of the Florida Young Birders Club. She is now exploring colleges to major in environmental studies and pursue biophilic design.

Critics point out that the design bears a striking resemblance to intricate Gujarati craftsmanship without proper recognition. Fendi defends the bag's creation, asserting it was meticulously made in Mumbai by the esteemed Chanakya workshop, emphasizing its collaboration with local artisans and their traditional skills.

author: TOI REAL ESTATE DESK
description: In response to their new Ohio mansion purchase for $5.35 million, Taylor Swift and Travis Kelce are ramping up security. The lavish lakefront property includes a voice warning system that alerts when someone approaches the premises too closely. Meanwhile, local law enforcement patrolling the exclusive Bratenahl village raises questions among residents about the implications of having such high-profile neighbors.

Inmates have also been caught celebrating birthdays and smoking hookahs inside prison.

description: Aryna Sabalenka endured a painful end to her US Open campaign, losing both the world No. 1 ranking and the title within 72 hours. Elena Rybakina first secured the top ranking before defeating Sabalenka 6-4, 5-7, 6-2 in the final. The loss left Sabalenka without a Grand Slam title in 2026, ending her bid for a third straight US Open crown. Despite the setback, she remained determined to reclaim No. 1.

Understanding what ambition gives and takes away is crucial for career decisions.

These operatives allegedly enlisted an individual within the U.S. to carry out surveillance and even plans for murder. Additionally, their network has been linked to targeting supporters of Ukraine across various European nations, with all five defendants still at large and presumed innocent.

description: Uttarakhand's initiative for rural tourism thrives through its homestay scheme, designed to provide financial support for local property owners. Successful applicants, who must be residents and property owners, can access subsidies and interest grants to aid in construction and renovations. The application is initiated online and assessed by district-level committees, with funds released only after project completion and satisfactory inspections.

description: Sanju Samson highlighted the importance of team objectives over individual rivalries and societal expectations. He mentioned that selections hinge on a player’s current form and the imperative to secure victories. Acknowledging external pressures, he noted that experience aids in navigating them. Samson concluded that players should always prioritize team dynamics, even amid personal challenges, as evidenced by his key role in steering India to a series win against Afghanistan.

description: The injured woman biker will undergo X-rays and MRI scans at a Delhi hospital. She alleged the accused deliberately chased and rammed her vehicle on Golf Course Road. This evolving threat challenges American military assets across the region.

description: In a significant legislative move, the US House has supported a bill enabling President Trump to enact tariffs. Consequently, Indian exports to the United States might be subjected to steep tariffs as high as 100 percent. An important vote on this matter is forthcoming in the House.

author: TIMESOFINDIA.COM
description: Sleep is often underestimated in its role in maintaining health, overshadowed by diet and exercise. A physician noted that inadequate sleep can lead to heart-related issues. Sleep is essential for regulating appetite, blood sugar levels, and immune response in adults. Irregular sleep patterns can heighten cardiovascular risks and raise stress hormones. It is recommended to strive for a consistent seven to nine hours of quality sleep each night.

The Gambits captain helped his GCL side bounce back to bronze, and now turns his focus to India’s Chess Olympiad campaign, confident a young, tightly knit squad can deliver.

description: Keralam travel vlogger Arunima I P has reassured her followers of her safety in Afghanistan after a previous post sparked alarm about her arrest in Bamyan. Authorities had interrogated her due to her solo travel without a male escort or guide. Thanks to local support, she was able to continue her explorations despite lacking an official permit, calming concerns from her audience and the Indian embassy.

description: After a decade of operation, Priscilla Chan's $125 million school has officially closed its doors. description: In a groundbreaking ecological revival, old dams on the Coonamessett River in Massachusetts were dismantled, restoring wetlands and providing passage for migratory fish. This project repurposed industrial farmland into a flourishing coastal ecosystem, allowing fish to ascend to upstream spawning spots that had been blocked for years.
